The adapter discussion now tests these requirements against HSBC hidden text, Docling partial/OCR/model-identity behavior, OTSL geometry and Arelle dependency and value handling. exit_state: Chapter13 closes with native-XBRL source selection and a PDF comparator, while separating source selection, resolved environment and executed compatibility. Inline transformations, occurrence preservation, duplicate comparisons and the Apple annual/interim matches establish concrete exchange requirements. Dependency ranges constrain a future environment but do not establish installation, validation, licenses for all components or runtime acceptance. Chapter14 must now state the evidence needed to accept the design and its implementation.
